# wallix.bastion.device_localdomain

Manage local domains of a device on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete a local domain of a device on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain` Terraform resource.
- Accounts of the local domain are managed with [`wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account`](device_localdomain_account.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-admin-account"></a>**admin_account** | `str` | Name of the account of this local domain used to change the passwords of the other accounts.<br>The Bastion only accepts it on an existing local domain whose account already exists, so it cannot be set when the local domain is created. Set it in a later task. |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-ca-private-key"></a>**ca_private_key** | `str` | Private key of the SSH certificate authority of the local domain, or `generate:<type>` to have the Bastion generate one, for example `generate:ED25519` or `generate:RSA_4096`.<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-description"></a>**description** | `str` | Description of the local domain. |
| <a id="parameter-device-name"></a>**device_name** | `str` / required | Name of the device the local domain belongs to. The device must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the local domain. Identifies the local domain on the device. |
| <a id="parameter-enable-password-change"></a>**enable_password_change** | `bool` | Whether the Bastion changes the passwords of the accounts of this local domain.<br>Requires [`password_change_policy`](#parameter-password-change-policy) and [`password_change_plugin`](#parameter-password-change-plugin). |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase of [`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key).<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-plugin"></a>**password_change_plugin** | `str` | Name of the password change plugin, for example `Unix`. |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters"></a>**password_change_plugin_parameters** | `dict` | Parameters of the password change plugin.<br>Treated as a secret, see [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-password-change-policy"></a>**password_change_policy** | `str` | Name of the password change policy, for example `default`. |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the local domain should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends [`ca_private_key`](#parameter-ca-private-key), [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase) and [`password_change_plugin_parameters`](#parameter-password-change-plugin-parameters) only when the local domain is created.<br>`always` sends them on every run, which then always reports a change. With [`ca_private_key=generate:<type>`](#parameter-ca-private-key), this generates a new key on every run.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- Options left unset keep their current value on the Bastion.
- With [`state=absent`](#parameter-state), a missing device is not an error.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Declare a local domain with a generated SSH certificate authority
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    description: Local accounts of srv-linux-01
    ca_private_key: generate:ED25519

- name: Let the Bastion rotate the passwords of the local accounts
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    admin_account: root
    enable_password_change: true
    password_change_policy: default
    password_change_plugin: Unix
    password_change_plugin_parameters: {}

- name: Remove a local domain
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that differed from the Bastion and were updated.<br>Contains the secret options that were set when [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the local domain already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["description"]` |
| <a id="return-localdomain"></a>**localdomain** | `dict` | The local domain as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without the secret options.<br>In check mode, the expected local domain. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-localdomain) |

<a id="sample-localdomain"></a>

### Sample of `localdomain`

```yaml
admin_account: null
ca_public_key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC8AUFSJcx+fgI7j0JboX1MhgxEot4gYI1sJubI9HsG3
description: Local accounts of srv-linux-01
domain_name: local
enable_password_change: false
id: 1a0f6db6cad64f53005056b66c8b
password_change_plugin: null
password_change_policy: null
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/devices/1a0f6db040c0b839005056b66c8b/localdomains/1a0f6db6cad64f53005056b66c8b
```
